title: 生物除磷程序~Enhanced biological phosphorus removal
focus: 厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合~Closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting
summary: 本課以厭氧釋磷、好氧吸磷與排泥閉合為主線，從總磷與溶解磷、厭氧選擇區、可利用碳與磷比例、厭氧釋磷觀察進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops closing anaerobic release, aerobic uptake and phosphorus wasting through ten connected units, beginning with total and dissolved phosphorus, anaerobic selection zone, available carbon-to-p balance, anaerobic release observation. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 總磷與溶解磷~Total and dissolved phosphorus
units.mechanism: 先分清顆粒磷與溶解磷，才能區分生物吸收不足及固體分離問題。~Distinguish particulate from dissolved P to separate poor uptake from separation problems.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=2500 m³/d；TP=6 mg P/L。模型 LP=QCP/1000，代入得到 15 kg P/d。適用邊界：TP 與溶解性磷須分開；流量加權後再計算。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=2500 m³/d; TP=6 mg P/L. Model LP=QCP/1000 gives 15 kg P/d. Applicability: Separate total and dissolved phosphorus; use flow weighting.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「總磷與溶解磷」的觀測點。對照總磷消化分析與過濾樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total and dissolved phosphorus. Compare digested total-P analysis with filtered samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只量正磷酸鹽會漏算顆粒磷。診斷與介入：重測總磷與溶解磷，將固體分離和水相反應分開診斷。~Orthophosphate alone misses particulate phosphorus. Diagnostic response: Remeasure total/dissolved P and diagnose solids separation separately from aqueous reactions.
units.misconception: 正磷酸鹽就是全部總磷。~Orthophosphate is all total phosphorus.
units.practice: 只改變 TP:6→8 mg P/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 20 kg P/d。用「總磷與溶解磷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TP:6→8 mg P/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 20 kg P/d. Explain the direction using total and dissolved phosphorus, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 厭氧選擇區~Anaerobic selection zone
units.mechanism: 厭氧區不應混入氧或硝酸鹽競爭電子供體，功能與缺氧區不同。~An anaerobic zone excludes oxygen/nitrate competition for donor and differs from an anoxic zone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=150 m³；Q=3600 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 1 h。適用邊界：局部槽體的名義時間，不是生物反應完成時間。~Original teaching assumptions: V=150 m³; Q=3600 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 1 h. Applicability: Nominal time in one compartment, not a guarantee of biological completion.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「厭氧選擇區」的觀測點。把分區入口與出口示蹤時間畫成圖。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic selection zone. Plot tracer arrival at the compartment inlet and outlet. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 內回流夾帶硝酸鹽破壞選擇作用。診斷與介入：查分隔牆與旁流，將有效容積重新列入區段模型。~Nitrate carryover undermines selection. Diagnostic response: Check baffles and bypass streams and update the compartment effective volume.
units.misconception: 厭氧與缺氧完全相同。~Anaerobic and anoxic are identical.
units.practice: 只改變 V:150→180 m³，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 1.2 h。用「厭氧選擇區」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only V:150→180 m³, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 1.2 h. Explain the direction using anaerobic selection zone, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 可利用碳與磷比例~Available carbon-to-P balance
units.mechanism: 聚磷菌需要合適的可利用碳；總 COD 高不代表 VFA 足夠。~PAOs require suitable available carbon; high total COD does not imply enough VFA.
units.model: 原創教學假設：可利用 COD=120 kg/d；需移除 P=8 kg/d。模型 C/P=COD/P，代入得到 15 kg COD/kg P。適用邊界：進流水質指標而非通用最低需求；須區分 VFA 與其他 COD。~Original teaching assumptions: Available COD=120 kg/d; P to remove=8 kg/d. Model C/P=COD/P gives 15 kg COD/kg P. Applicability: An influent-quality indicator, not a universal minimum requirement; distinguish VFA from other COD.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「可利用碳與磷比例」的觀測點。將 VFA、可快速降解 COD 與正磷酸鹽一起採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for available carbon-to-p balance. Sample VFA, readily biodegradable COD and orthophosphate together. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把難分解 COD 算入有效供碳。診斷與介入：分析 VFA 及可快速分解 COD，區分可利用比例。~Refractory COD is counted as effective carbon. Diagnostic response: Analyze VFA/readily biodegradable COD to distinguish availability.
units.misconception: 總 COD 高就不會缺碳。~High total COD eliminates carbon limitation.
units.practice: 只改變 COD:120→80 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 15 變為 10 kg COD/kg P。用「可利用碳與磷比例」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only COD:120→80 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 15 to 10 kg COD/kg P. Explain the direction using available carbon-to-p balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 厭氧釋磷觀察~Anaerobic release observation
units.mechanism: 厭氧時水相磷上升可反映儲存轉換，須與碳吸收、停留時間一起看。~Aqueous P release can reflect storage conversion; interpret it with carbon uptake and residence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=1000 m³/d；厭氧槽 PO4-P 由 3 增為 8 mg/L。模型 Prelease=Q(Cout-Cin)/1000，代入得到 5 kg P/d。適用邊界：無旁流的水相差額，非整廠除磷；需納入胞內儲存。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=1000 m³/d; anaerobic PO4-P increases from 3 to 8 mg/L. Model Prelease=Q(Cout-Cin)/1000 gives 5 kg P/d. Applicability: A water-phase difference without side flows, not plant-wide P removal; intracellular storage matters.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「厭氧釋磷觀察」的觀測點。依流動延遲配對入口與出口採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic release observation. Pair inlet and outlet samples using the hydraulic delay. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只憑釋磷判定全廠磷已去除。診斷與介入：按水力延遲配對採樣，檢查硝酸鹽和氧入侵。~Release alone is mistaken for plant removal. Diagnostic response: Pair samples by hydraulic lag and check nitrate/oxygen intrusion.
units.misconception: 釋磷越多代表出水磷越低。~More release necessarily means lower effluent P.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:8→10 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 5 變為 7 kg P/d。用「厭氧釋磷觀察」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:8→10 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 5 to 7 kg P/d. Explain the direction using anaerobic release observation, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 好氧吸磷~Aerobic uptake
units.mechanism: 吸收把水相磷轉入固體，永久排出仍依靠富磷污泥移出。~Uptake transfers aqueous P to solids; permanent export needs wasting of P-rich sludge.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=1000 m³/d；好氧槽 PO4-P 由 8 降至 1 mg/L。模型 Puptake=Q(Cin-Cout)/1000，代入得到 7 kg P/d。適用邊界：水相吸收不等於永久移除，最終必須經排泥離開邊界。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=1000 m³/d; aerobic PO4-P decreases from 8 to 1 mg/L. Model Puptake=Q(Cin-Cout)/1000 gives 7 kg P/d. Applicability: Uptake from water is not permanent removal; P must leave through wasting.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「好氧吸磷」的觀測點。同時追蹤水相 P 與污泥含磷率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for aerobic uptake. Track aqueous P and sludge P content simultaneously. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 吸磷後不排泥會讓磷留在系統。診斷與介入：把吸磷與含磷排泥一起檢查，不只比水相濃度。~Without wasting, phosphorus remains in the system. Diagnostic response: Check uptake together with P-rich wasting, not aqueous concentration alone.
units.misconception: 水相吸磷就是永久除磷。~Uptake is permanent phosphorus removal.
units.practice: 只改變 Cout:1→2 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 7 變為 6 kg P/d。用「好氧吸磷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Cout:1→2 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 7 to 6 kg P/d. Explain the direction using aerobic uptake, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 富磷排泥~Phosphorus-rich wasting
units.mechanism: 排泥量與乾基含磷率一起決定排出的磷質量。~Wasted dry mass and its P fraction determine phosphorus export.
units.model: 原創教學假設：乾固體排泥=150 kg/d；污泥 P 質量分率=0.04。模型 Pout=MDS fP，代入得到 6 kg P/d。適用邊界：均勻代表樣本與乾基含磷率；濕污泥重量不能直接代入。~Original teaching assumptions: Dry solids wasted=150 kg/d; sludge P fraction=0.04. Model Pout=MDS fP gives 6 kg P/d. Applicability: Representative sampling and dry-basis P fraction; wet sludge mass cannot be substituted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「富磷排泥」的觀測點。稱重乾固體後分析 P，與水線進出量閉合。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for phosphorus-rich wasting. Measure dry mass and P content and close the balance against the water line. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 濕泥重量造成固體與磷高估。診斷與介入：重算乾固體與乾基含磷率，將濕重和元素質量分開。~Wet mass overstates solids and phosphorus. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry solids and dry-basis P content separately from wet mass.
units.misconception: 泥餅越濕排出的磷越多。~Wetter cake exports more phosphorus.
units.practice: 只改變 MDS:150→180 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 6 變為 7.2 kg P/d。用「富磷排泥」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only MDS:150→180 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 6 to 7.2 kg P/d. Explain the direction using phosphorus-rich wasting, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 硝酸鹽入侵~Nitrate intrusion
units.mechanism: 回流硝酸鹽先消耗碳，可能使厭氧儲碳功能減弱。~Recycled nitrate consumes carbon before anaerobic storage and can weaken selection.
units.model: 原創教學假設：NO3-N 去除量=30 kg/d；電子當量=2.86 kg COD/kg N。模型 CODmin=2.86×N，代入得到 85.8 kg COD/d。適用邊界：僅硝酸鹽還原的理論電子當量；不含菌體合成、溶氧與其他耗碳。~Original teaching assumptions: NO3-N removed=30 kg/d; electron equivalent=2.86 kg COD/kg N. Model CODmin=2.86×N gives 85.8 kg COD/d. Applicability: Theoretical nitrate electron equivalent only; biomass synthesis, DO and other carbon demand are omitted.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「硝酸鹽入侵」的觀測點。獨立量測 NO3-N、NO2-N、可利用 COD，避免把總 COD 全算可用。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrate intrusion. Measure NO3-N, NO2-N and available COD separately rather than treating all COD as usable. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只調曝氣而不追蹤回流硝酸鹽。診斷與介入：查可利用碳與攜入氧，先核對電子供體收支。~Changing aeration alone misses recycle nitrate. Diagnostic response: Check available carbon and oxygen carryover, then close the donor balance.
units.misconception: 硝酸鹽進厭氧區完全沒有影響。~Nitrate entering the anaerobic zone has no effect.
units.practice: 只改變 N:30→36 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 85.8 變為 102.96 kg COD/d。用「硝酸鹽入侵」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:30→36 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 85.8 to 102.96 kg COD/d. Explain the direction using nitrate intrusion, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 顆粒磷逃逸~Particulate phosphorus escape
units.mechanism: 低溶解磷仍可能伴隨出流水固體帶出的高總磷。~Low dissolved P can coexist with high total P carried by effluent solids.
units.model: 原創教學假設：出流水 TSS=10 mg/L；固體含磷率=0.04。模型 Ppart=TSS fP，代入得到 0.4 mg P/L。適用邊界：把固體組成當固定的教學近似；還須加上溶解磷。~Original teaching assumptions: Effluent TSS=10 mg/L; solids P fraction=0.04. Model Ppart=TSS fP gives 0.4 mg P/L. Applicability: Assumes constant solids composition; dissolved P must also be included.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒磷逃逸」的觀測點。比較過濾前後總磷與 TSS。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for particulate phosphorus escape. Compare filtered/unfiltered phosphorus with TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只優化菌相而忽略沉澱與過濾。診斷與介入：比較過濾前後磷與 TSS，優先診斷固體逃逸。~Optimizing biology while neglecting separation leaves P losses. Diagnostic response: Compare filtered/unfiltered P and TSS, first diagnosing solids escape.
units.misconception: 溶解磷低就能推論總磷低。~Low dissolved P proves low total P.
units.practice: 只改變 TSS:10→15 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.4 變為 0.6 mg P/L。用「顆粒磷逃逸」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only TSS:10→15 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.4 to 0.6 mg P/L. Explain the direction using particulate phosphorus escape, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 污泥齡折衷~Sludge-age trade-off
units.mechanism: 保留菌體與排出磷須共同安排，不能只追求最大固體庫存。~Coordinate biomass retention and P export rather than maximizing inventory alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。~Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「污泥齡折衷」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-age trade-off. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 排泥過低使磷出口不足。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。~Insufficient wasting restricts P export. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
units.misconception: 不排泥能永久提高除磷。~Eliminating wasting permanently improves P removal.
units.practice: 只改變 W:180→230 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 22.5 變為 18 d。用「污泥齡折衷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only W:180→230 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 22.5 to 18 d. Explain the direction using sludge-age trade-off, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 全廠磷閉合~Whole-plant phosphorus closure
units.mechanism: 把進流、出水、污泥、側流與庫存放在同一磷收支。~Place influent, effluent, sludge, sidestreams and inventory in one P balance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。~Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「全廠磷閉合」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for whole-plant phosphorus closure. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 無法閉合時先檢查採樣與旁流而非宣布磷消失。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。~Check sampling/side streams before declaring missing phosphorus vanished. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
units.misconception: 磷可像氮一樣直接當作氣體消失。~Phosphorus can simply vanish as gas like nitrogen.
units.practice: 只改變 Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1 變為 0.5 kg/d。用「全廠磷閉合」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Msludge:12→12.5 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1 to 0.5 kg/d. Explain the direction using whole-plant phosphorus closure, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
